description: Find the morning and evening golden-hour windows for photography from any date and latitude — or your own sunrise/sunset.

faqs.a: Golden hour is roughly the first hour after sunrise and the last hour before sunset, when the sun is low and light is warm and soft.
Enter a date and latitude and the tool derives sunrise/sunset with solar equations. Or type your own sunrise/sunset times directly.
faqs.q: Do I need my sunrise and sunset times?

faqs.a: Yes — near the poles in summer/winter there may be no sunrise/sunset, and the tool will say so instead of guessing.
faqs.q: Does it work near the poles?

howto: Enter a date and latitude to auto-compute sunrise/sunset — or type them manually.
Add longitude + UTC offset for local clock times.
Read your morning and evening golden-hour windows.
title: Golden Hour Calculator
